1339-1832-4050-6634.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-4050-6634.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2113-3525-7208.description:
Activate Pestered Wellguard by tapping it, adding {U}.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Pestered Wellguard.
Repeat.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

967-997-5220-7855--180.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Goblin, Orc or Army.
967-997-5220-7855--180.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat

3755-7296-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3755-7296-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3755-7296-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more counters on it

687-2404-5413-6099.notablePrerequisites: There are three removable counters among creatures you control excluding the first three +1/+1 counters on Mossborn Hydra.
687-2404-5413-6099.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Gaea's Cradle from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Gaea's Cradle enters, Mossborn Hydra triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
687-2404-5413-6099.notes: The prerequisite can be waived if Mossborn Hydra has six or more counters on it.

1018-4872-7631.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Skullwinder
When the Skullwinder token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1824-2530-6556-7359.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-6556-7359.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
1824-2530-6556-7359.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Tablet of the Guilds triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

252-2440-3263-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {5}, creating a token copy of it. It will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
When the Improvised Arsenal token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Dinosaur you control.
Repeat.
252-2440-3263-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more Dinosaurs as the combo begins.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

647-1563-3129-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

413-628-3108.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Grim Poppet enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
413-628-3108.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

678-5271-5670.description:
Cast Healer of the Glade by paying {G}.
When Healer of the Glade enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 3 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Healer of the Glade
When Healer of the Glade dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Healer of the Glade from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

880-5478-6529.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-5478-6529.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the land enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1817-2981-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue token.
1817-2981-5365.description:
Cast Lonis by paying {1}{G/U}{G/U}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, creating a nonlegendary copy of the Lonis spell.
Resolve both Lonis spells.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat from step 4.
1817-2981-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

478-2821-3257-3664-3918.notablePrerequisites: Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
478-2821-3257-3664-3918.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Minamo, Lotus Field and Rakdos Carnarium.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat from step 3.

1887-3129-4636-5770.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating two 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

2232-2837-3652-5270.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Samwise Gamgee's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
When the Cat enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Ornithopter from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

940-2178-5368.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
940-2178-5368.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1533-2051-2546-2657.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
1533-2051-2546-2657.description:
Activate Secluded Steppe's cycling ability by paying {W} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Secluded Steppe ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ayula's Influence by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Ayula's Influence ability, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{W}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Secluded Steppe and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1594-3532-3594-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

539-1300-2372.notablePrerequisites:
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two mana-producing lands except Weaver of Harmony, one of which must be a Forest.
539-1300-2372.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Wilderness Reclamation triggers.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing lands you control except Weaver of Harmony by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Wilderness Reclamation's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Wilderness Reclamation's trigger, untapping all lands you control and tapping all lands the defending player controls.
Repeat from step 2.

1608-4659-5003.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Triplicate Titan, adding {C}{C}.
Triplicate Titan dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Triplicate Titan trigger, creating three 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Golem, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Triplicate Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

2034-4385-4893.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Sliver token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
